description: D31: the agent's state.db truncated, its header overwritten, and a middle page overwritten; startup refuses without serving or writing, and the restored store starts with the earlier task's record intact.

inputs.agent: transient Rust agents of the installed release candidate (0.3.0) under /tmp/e2e-agents

requirements.requirement: A damaged state store stops startup
requirements.scenario: Truncated store, and an overwritten header: startup exits non-zero, binds nothing and writes nothing; the restored store starts with its records intact (D31)

requirements.requirement: A damaged state store stops startup
requirements.scenario: A page overwritten in the middle: the agent either refuses to start or serves; it does not crash while starting

steps.guest: python3 /opt/opute-e2e/guest/e2etool.py agent start dmg --port 3041 --id e2e-dmg-agent --env MCP_AUTH_TOKEN=${SECRET:dmg} --env OPUTE_STANDALONE_ALLOW_MUTATIONS=true
python3 /opt/opute-e2e/guest/e2etool.py agent stop dmg && cp -a /tmp/e2e-agents/dmg/state/state.db /tmp/e2e-agents/dmg/state.db.bak && echo saved
truncate -s 4096 /tmp/e2e-agents/dmg/state/state.db && sha256sum /tmp/e2e-agents/dmg/state/state.db | cut -c1-64; ls /tmp/e2e-agents/dmg/state | tr '\n' ' '; echo

python3 /opt/opute-e2e/guest/e2etool.py agent start dmg --port 3041 --id e2e-dmg-agent --env MCP_AUTH_TOKEN=${SECRET:dmg} --env OPUTE_STANDALONE_ALLOW_MUTATIONS=true >/dev/null 2>&1; echo exit=$?; python3 /opt/opute-e2e/guest/e2etool.py agent stop dmg >/dev/null

cp -a /tmp/e2e-agents/dmg/state.db.bak /tmp/e2e-agents/dmg/state/state.db && dd if=/dev/urandom of=/tmp/e2e-agents/dmg/state/state.db bs=100 count=1 conv=notrunc 2>/dev/null && sha256sum /tmp/e2e-agents/dmg/state/state.db | cut -c1-64; ls /tmp/e2e-agents/dmg/state | tr '\n' ' '; echo

python3 /opt/opute-e2e/guest/e2etool.py agent start dmg --port 3041 --id e2e-dmg-agent --env MCP_AUTH_TOKEN=${SECRET:dmg} --env OPUTE_STANDALONE_ALLOW_MUTATIONS=true >/dev/null 2>&1; echo exit=$?; python3 /opt/opute-e2e/guest/e2etool.py agent stop dmg >/dev/null
cp -a /tmp/e2e-agents/dmg/state.db.bak /tmp/e2e-agents/dmg/state/state.db && dd if=/dev/urandom of=/tmp/e2e-agents/dmg/state/state.db bs=4096 seek=2 count=1 conv=notrunc 2>/dev/null && echo damaged
python3 /opt/opute-e2e/guest/e2etool.py agent start dmg --port 3041 --id e2e-dmg-agent --env MCP_AUTH_TOKEN=${SECRET:dmg} --env OPUTE_STANDALONE_ALLOW_MUTATIONS=true >/dev/null 2>&1; echo exit=$?
python3 /opt/opute-e2e/guest/e2etool.py agent stop dmg >/dev/null; echo stopped
python3 /opt/opute-e2e/guest/e2etool.py agent start dmg --port 3041 --id e2e-dmg-agent --env MCP_AUTH_TOKEN=${SECRET:dmg} --env OPUTE_STANDALONE_ALLOW_MUTATIONS=true
